scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=@kenoracric/api" "npm run dev --workspace=@kenoracric/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kenoracric/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@kenoracric/cricket-engine && npm run build --workspace=@kenoracric/api-client && npm run build --workspace=@kenoracric/api && npm run build --workspace=@kenoracric/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
